title: French Ginger Crepes with Zesty Filling
description: Delicate French crepes filled with a zesty and refreshing ginger filling, perfect for a light snack or dessert.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the grated ginger, sugar, and lemon juice until well combined.
Add the zesty spread to the bowl and mix until smooth.
Heat a large skillet or crepe pan over medium heat.
Pour a small amount of melted butter into the pan and tilt to coat the surface.
Lay a crepe in the pan and cook for 30-45 seconds on each side, until lightly browned.
To assemble the crepes, place a cooked crepe on a flat surface and spread a tablespoon of the ginger filling down the center of the crepe.
Roll the crepe up tightly and repeat with the remaining crepes and filling.
Serve the crepes warm or at room temperature, garnished with additional grated ginger if desired.
